title: All Four Projections
gallery_text: The hundred-year storm at today's sea level, with the four published projections for 2100 drawn as lines over it. No middle line, because the panel does not publish one.
description: The 09-08 rebuild draws every projection rather than one. The fill is the storm today; the four lines are the same storm plus the 10th, 25th, 75th and 90th percentiles for 2100.
